build_solver_from_config: build a solver from a ToraxConfig dict with solver_type set to linear, newton_raphson, or optimizer
test_solver_under_jit: test that a SolverConfig compiles once under jax.jit and updates values without recompilation
create_ToraxConfig_from_dict: create a ToraxConfig instance from a dictionary using model_config.ToraxConfig.from_dict
build_runtime_params: build runtime params from a SolverConfig instance via the build_runtime_params property
update_solver_fields: update solver config fields in-place using _update_fields without triggering jax recompilation
